items.summary_orig: Smartphones make telematics more accessible by combining location, motion sensors, computing power, and connectivity in a single device. items.summary_orig: Hi HN, I ported ESM Cambrian 300M — a protein language model — from PyTorch to C++ on top of ggml. The F16 output matches the PyTorch reference at a per-residue cosine of 0.9999996 across 10k Swiss-Prot sequences.

items.title_orig: The Simons Observatory is Online and Surveying the Cosmic Microwave Background
items.summary: 西蒙斯天文台已上线，正在以比以往任何时候都更高的精度观测宇宙微波背景（CMB）。它正在寻找由原始引力波引起的微小 CMB 涨落。如果能探测到这些波，将是我们迄今为止最接近于确凿证据的
items.summary_orig: The Simons Observatory is online and surveying the Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB) in greater detail than ever before. It's looking for tiny fluctuations in the CMB caused by primordial gravitational waves. These waves, if detected, would be as close to slam-dunk evidence for the Big Bang that we can expect to find.

items.title: 天王星和海王星其实是「岩石巨星」？一种稀有气体或能解答
items.title_orig: Are Uranus and Neptune Secretly "Rock Giants"? A Noble Gas Might Hold the Answer

items.summary_orig: For decades, astronomers have divided the planets in the outer solar system into two distinct camps. Jupiter and Saturn were the “gas giants” made up primarily of hydrogen and helium. Uranus and Neptune were the “ice giants”, and were much smaller but were packed with heavier elements.

items.summary_orig: NASA launched a new competition inviting U.S. companies to produce prototypes of mid-power Hall effect thrusters – a type of electric propulsion system considered crucial for future space operations and exploration.
